HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient seen and examined at bedside. 83-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.65, creatinine 1.02, hemoglobin 13.6, platelets 289, sodium 134, wbc 6.2; vitals dbp 70-75, heart_rate 79-84, map 87-92, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-16, sbp 120-126, spo2 97-99, temp 36.9-37.1
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 1.01, hemoglobin 13.5, platelets 285, sodium 138, wbc 6.3; vitals dbp 69-74, heart_rate 79-83, map 87-90, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-16, sbp 120-127, spo2 97-99, temp 36.9-37.1
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 83-year-old male, length of stay 2 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. Follow up with primary care in one week. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed.
